title: Control flow from job/repo creation to execution and status writeback
answers: How does a Job get validated/mutated before execution?
What's the chokepoint for building a live Repository client?
How does job/sync status get written back to the Repository object?
How do inbound git webhooks get processed?
body:
1. Job create -> admission webhook: pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/register.go:871 registers appjobs.NewAdmissionMutator(userAttributionEnabled) which is apps/provisioning/pkg/jobs/mutator.go:AdmissionMutator.Mutate; validation is apps/provisioning/pkg/jobs/validator.go:ValidateJob.
2. Repository/Connection construction -> Factory: pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/extras/register.go:93/:110 call repository.ProvideFactory and connection.ProvideFactory (apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/factory.go), wiring one Extra impl per type (git/github/local, github/githuboauth/oauth). All callers (job workers, HTTP handlers, webhook processing) go through factory.Build, the single chokepoint for constructing a live repository client incl. secret decryption.
3. Job execution: workers in pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/jobs/driver.go and .../jobs/{sync,export,migrate,delete,move,fixfoldermetadata,deleteresources,releaseresources}/worker.go call methods on the repository.Repository built above, including IsWriteAllowed in apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/workflows.go.
4. Inbound git-provider webhooks land in pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/webhooks/ and are normalized via each backend's WebhookClient (apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/webhook.go, pkg/repository/github/webhook.go).
5. Status writeback: controller.RepositoryStatusPatcher.Patch (apps/provisioning/pkg/controller/status.go) is how job/controller code in the main module writes results back onto the Repository status subresource, with retry on k8s conflicts and SQLITE_BUSY.
